verses.text: Praise ye Jehovah. Sing unto Jehovah a new song, And his praise in the assembly of the saints.

segments.text: Praise ye Jehovah.

verses.text: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

segments.text: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him:

verses.text: Let them praise his name in the dance: Let them sing praises unto him with timbrel and harp.

segments.text: Let them praise his name in the dance:

verses.text: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people: He will beautify the meek with salvation.

segments.text: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people:

verses.text: Let the saints exult in glory: Let them sing for joy upon their beds.

segments.text: Let the saints exult in glory:

verses.text: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;

verses.text: To execute vengeance upon the nations, And punishments upon the peoples;

verses.text: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;
